title: Geist: Extra Charge at 7.2k (right after Life Drain T3) vs 16.8k (after Berserker)
question: Is the 4th drain charge worth delaying Radiant Regeneration, Healing Booster, Spirit Resilience and Berserker by 800 souls each?
hypothesis: Calc (geist_paths.txt G5 vs G0): at 12.8k G5 drain bank 1758 vs 1221 but 481 less HP (no Spirit Resilience yet); at 16k G5 has 16% less weapon damage. Prediction: in a 20s 1v1 the extra charge only matters if all 3 base charges get used; G0 wins short fights, G5 long ones.

setup.level_or_boons: level 20, Life Drain T3, Malice T2

procedure: use all drain charges as they come up
record damage dealt, healing done and HP at the end at 10s and at 20s

decision.rule: SUPPORTS G5 (move Extra Charge to 7.2k) only if G5 beats G0 by >=10% at 20s AND is within 5% at 10s; else keep G0.
